title: wpsld: a desktop editor for RO-Crate metadata
description: wpsld is a desktop editor for RO-Crate metadata. It describes files and folders with schema.org-based Linked Data and saves the result as ro-crate-metadata.json, with forms narrowed by RO-Crate profiles. Its command-line tool, wpsld-cli, checks, repairs and previews crates.
notes: Funded by BioFAIR Method Commons, BBSRC, UKRI.
